items.q: How does the first meeting work?
items.a: We begin with an introductory call to get to know each other, discuss your initial request and goals, and explore how we might work together. There is no obligation to continue — we can both decide whether it feels right to move forward.

Yes. Our introductory meeting takes place online, and most of the process is built around online sessions. However, if we happen to be based in the same area or you would prefer to meet in person and are willing to travel, we can discuss the possibilities.

items.q: What are the session duration and fees?
items.a:
We discuss the session format, duration, and fees during our initial conversation and agree on a way forward that works for both of us.

I believe this work should be accessible to those who genuinely feel drawn to it. If your financial circumstances are a concern, please reach out anyway. We can discuss the possibilities and hopefully find a solution that works for you.

Absolutely. Your personal information and everything you share during our sessions remain confidential. No information about you or your personal journey is shared publicly, and sessions are never recorded.

items.q: What is the appropriate age for these sessions?
items.a: I currently work with individuals aged 14 and above. For anyone under 18, written parental consent is required, in accordance with the applicable requirements.

No. These sessions are not psychological counselling or conventional mental training, although we may occasionally explore elements that overlap with these approaches.

The sessions are focused on developing your relationship with your intuition and instinct. They are not a substitute for medical care or psychological therapy when these are needed.

items.q: Do I need any knowledge or background to start this work? What if I’ve never experienced intuition?
items.a: We all connect with ourselves in different ways. You don’t need any special preparation — just come as you are, with curiosity and a willingness to explore. You will find your own way of connecting to yourself.

items.q: I am not an athlete, but I feel I could benefit from these sessions. Can I reach out?
items.a:
Intuition and personal transformation are not exclusive to athletes — they are part of everyone’s life.

Sport represents a kind of quintessence of life, where experiences, emotions, and challenges can become particularly intense. This can make the role of intuition especially visible.

However, if you feel drawn to this work and are motivated to explore it, please reach out. We can discuss your needs and whether working together would be a good fit.
